clause: Plugin data, storage, codegen/text-review extensions, isolated UI [STU-AUT-019,STU-AUT-018]

scope.summary: Implement per-node plugin data (private + cross-plugin shared key-value, travelling with the document, namespaced), local client storage (plugin-local key-value separate from document data), codegen extension registration (register languages, emit code for the current selection), text-review extension (participate in a text-review pipeline over document text), and the isolated plugin UI surface with no direct access to native-shell internals, communicating with sandboxed plugin logic through a typed message channel.
acceptance_criteria: per-node/shared data + client storage + codegen/text-review extensions + isolated UI via typed channel
expected_tests: live: per-node private + shared plugin data round-trips with the document
test: codegen extension emits code for a selection; text-review extension participates
negative: plugin UI cannot reach native-shell internals (typed message channel only)

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Plugin data, storage & UI isolation

risk_if_missed: Plugin data/codegen/text-review parity dropped, or plugin UI escapes isolation.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
